provenance.reason: The three render CRCs follow the 3D player onto vanilla's ENTITY_IN_UI Lambertian. Each pixel they hash is the same geometry at the same pose under a different per-face shade: on the skull the three visible faces go 1.00000/0.59941/0.79873 to 1.00000/0.56864/0.44985, which is the harness reference's own measured triple, and sweep.player falls 29.1376 to 8.4315 over the same change. full_vanilla_iso and armored_full_vanilla_iso are gated by that sweep; skull_portrait is not, PORTRAIT being a perspective pose the reference tree holds no player at, so its value is the same relight applied at a pose nothing outside this pin measures.

armored_full_vanilla_iso.subject: Type.FULL + ArmorMaterial.IRON helmet/chestplate/leggings/boots, THREE_D, VANILLA_ISO, canvas 256, ssaa 1, aa off, steve skin

full_vanilla_iso.subject: Type.FULL, THREE_D, VANILLA_ISO, canvas 256, ssaa 1, aa off, steve skin
